# Trips Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Animated trails: a trip per row when Position reads a list of positions and Timestamp a list of times; otherwise vertex rows with a timestamp each. Current time is a deck prop, so playing costs no queries.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "trips", "name": "trips", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:currentTime`, or read elsewhere as `ch('trips/currentTime')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
